title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
slides: Can ChatGPT spend your money without asking?
OpenAI's Dots agents now complete purchases on your behalf
But they decide how and when to checkout themselves
Card details and limits get logged per agent action
Set one spending cap before your first agent buys
thread_text:
1. Your AI just bought something

OpenAI's Dots agents now complete purchases on your behalf, and they decide how and when to checkout without asking you first.

2. They choose the moment

You set the goal, but the agent picks the timing and method. It's not waiting for your approval at the cart.

3. Every move is logged

Card details and spending limits get recorded per agent action, so you can trace exactly what was charged and when.

4. One cap before they buy

Set a single spending limit before your first agent purchase. Without it, the agent operates on its own judgment.

5. Would you hand over your card?

Open ChatGPT and check if your agent can spend without a cap. If you haven't set one, do it today.
